findings.function: submitExchangeRateData, submitValidatorStats, submitValidatorVerificationDetail, submitWithdrawnValidators vs set*UpdateFrequency, get*ReportableBlock, initialize
findings.issue: The same updateFrequencyMap entries have two names: stor278[key] where the code hashes the key, and separate variables stor78E4, stor6831, stor7A64, storBC6E (keccak(key . 278) of ETHX_ER, VALIDATOR_STATS, VALIDATOR_VERIFICATION_DETAIL and WITHDRAWN_VALIDATORS) where the slot is a constant; the reader cannot link the frequency set by setERUpdateFrequency with the modulus checked by submitExchangeRateData.
findings.rule: For every mapping base B and constant key k used with it, compute keccak(k . B) and print a constant slot equal to it as B[k] (keccak taken as collision-free), so one storage location keeps one name.
findings.verified: keccak computed for the six keys: 0x78e40c66.., 0x0683174e.. (printed with 63 digits as 0x683174ee..: P6), 0x7a641f2a.., 0xbc6eadc4.. match

findings.source: StaderOracle.sol:316-320 while ((j >= 1) && (_sdPrice < sdPrices[j - 1])) { sdPrices[j] = sdPrices[j - 1]; j--; } sdPrices[j] = _sdPrice; then :299 emit SDPriceSubmitted and :302 2 * trustedNodesCount
findings.issue: The insertion loop is printed as 'while True' whose two exits each carry a copy of the code after the loop (the final store, the SDPriceSubmitted event and the overflow check of 2 * trustedNodesCount), so the loop condition 'j >= 1 and price < sdPrices[j-1]' never appears and the event is printed three times.
findings.rule: When every exit of a 'while True' loop runs the same statements before leaving, move them after the loop and turn the exit tests into the loop condition ('while s >= 1 and _param2 < stor277[s - 1]').

notes: All 74 ABI functions and the fallback reviewed; no semantic difference found. Loops: StringsUpgradeable.toHexString's for (inlined twice in each of the five onlyRole functions; the role-0 instance is folded to writing '0'), insertSDPrice's while (obscure, finding) and submitMissedAttestationPenalties' for over the pubkeys; all whiles. Implicit: ABI encodes of the bytes[] arrays for keys, events and calls (readable whiles with copy lines; 14 in submitValidatorVerificationDetail) and seven memory-to-memory bytes copies (P7) in the key encodes and the sha256 input. P2: getPoolUtils/getNodeRegistry/markValidatorReadyToDeposit/withdrawnValidators calls after the encodes ('_30 = mem[64]' then 'len _30 - mem[64] + 4'), and getPubkeyRoot's InvalidPubkeyLength revert is raw memory for the same reason. P13: AccessControl's _roles[role].members printed as hasRole[role][account]; adminRole as stor[sha3(role, 101) + 1]. P11: getReportableBlockFor's '(n / f) * f' overflow test, toHexString/insertSDPrice bounds checks, 'length - 1 > length', initialize's 'not initializing' test, computeExchangeRate's division-by-zero test. P9: updateWithInLimitER's products distributed ('10000 * _17 - _17 * stor264'). Address/uint80 return checks print as slice comparisons ('x == ext_call.return_data[12 len 20]', '[22 len 10]') next to 'x == address(x)'. No execution run.
summary: Faithful, with readable straight-line code; the main problems are naming (one updateFrequencyMap entry under two names, len / 2 printed as 'stor277.field_1') and the insertion-sort loop printed as 'while True' with its tail and event duplicated into each exit.
